title: culture says English, the tool answers in Chinese (the measured trap)
titleZh: 区域是英文、工具却回中文(本机实测的坑)
why: MEASURED on the reference machine: (Get-Culture).Name is en-US while powercfg prints Chinese. Any implementation that picks its regular expressions from the detected culture fails here. This case forces -Lang en (English label file selected) while the tool output is Chinese: the verdict must still be reachable, i.e. the localized patterns must be merged from every label file, not selected by culture.
inject: -Lang en selected, Chinese netsh/powercfg tool text, cmdlet probe removed
expectSummary: NIC_PROFILE_ATTRIBUTION degraded/nic_ok and FIREWALL_PROFILES pass from CHINESE text while the English label file is active
